research_question: After replacing the temporary incomplete US level asset with an authoritative complete FRED history, does foreign information accumulated while A shares are closed add predictive information for the next CSI1000 opening gap?
financial_mechanism: China cannot absorb price discovery while A shares are closed. U.S. market closes occurring after the previous China close and before the target China open can therefore carry unabsorbed foreign information into the reopening gap.

external_data_contract.provider: Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis FRED

series.NASDAQCOM: Nasdaq Composite daily close; source reported by FRED as Nasdaq, Inc.
series.VIXCLS: CBOE Volatility Index daily close; source reported by FRED as Chicago Board Options Exchange

external_data_contract.calendar_rule: A weekday with a FRED row but missing NASDAQCOM/VIXCLS is retained as an explicit non-observation; never forward-fill across it. The usable U.S. market clock is defined by actual nonmissing observations, not weekday arithmetic.

time_boundary.target: CSI1000 next China session opening gap at the existing panel information boundary
time_boundary.start_us_level: latest joint NASDAQ/VIX observed close strictly before the previous China trading date
time_boundary.end_us_level: latest joint NASDAQ/VIX observed close strictly before the target China trading date
time_boundary.last_us_daily_return: return of the end U.S. observed close versus its immediately prior U.S. observed close
time_boundary.required_identity: closure_extra must equal zero (within 1e-12) whenever exactly one U.S. observed interval lies between start and end

internal_holdout: 2019-01-01 through 2020-12-31; already consumed, therefore not fresh OOS

attempts.role: regularization geometry placebo only, never selectable
attempts.features: baseline plus exact copies of us_nasdaq and us_vix_chg

primary_adjudication.progression_rule: C1 may progress only if it improves full-holdout IC versus C0, improves SSE on multiple-US-interval rows, does not derive its gain from one-US-interval rows, and the exact-duplicate placebo is materially weaker than C1 on the multiple-interval mechanism subset.
primary_adjudication.no_baseline_promotion: Because 2019-2020 is consumed internal holdout, even a pass only licenses a frozen hypothesis for later unseen-controller confirmation.
